Class Portfolio

java.lang.Object
ntnu.gruppe21.model.Portfolio
public class Portfolio extends Object
Portfolio class contains a list shares and contain methods to interact. For example: Methods for searching, filtering, checking and of course adding Share

    • removeShares

      public void removeShares(String symbol, int quantityToRemove)
      Removes the given quantity of shares for a stock symbol using FIFO order. Partial lots are split: the remainder stays in the portfolio with its original purchase price.
      Parameters:
      symbol - the stock symbol to remove shares for
      quantityToRemove - the total quantity to remove
